modalLead: Bookmark icons show up in the health view again — the same favicons you see on the dashboard — and the console 404s they caused are gone.

items.text: Health icons load again, no more console 404s — a bookmark's favicon showed on the dashboard but went missing in the health view, and the browser console filled with Failed to load resource: 404 errors that looked like something was broken when nothing was. The health view was requesting each icon by its bare filename from the site root (e.g. /unraid.png) instead of from /data/icons/ where the dashboard already loads it. It now resolves icons the same way the dashboard does, so the favicons appear and the console stays clean; a genuinely missing icon falls back to a 🔗 glyph instead of a broken image.
